description.zh: tr 翻译、dict AI 词典，支持 DeepL、微软翻译及 OpenAI 兼容模型服务；使用自己的密钥
description.en: tr translation and dict AI dictionary with your own DeepL, Microsoft Translator or OpenAI-compatible service key

notes.zh: 一次翻译几行文字时，每一行单独翻译，译文按原来的顺序一行一行交回；截图翻译靠它把译文对回原来的位置（LingCore/WinShun#191）。一行文字的翻译和以前完全一样。权限没有变化。设置 → 插件 → 插件库中安装或更新。最低主程序版本为 0.17.0。
notes.en: Several lines of text are translated each on its own and come back one line each, in order; this is how screenshot translation puts the translations back where the words were (LingCore/WinShun#191). A single line is sent exactly as before. Permissions are unchanged. Install or update through Settings → Plugins → Library. Requires WinShun 0.17.0.
